summary: A Harley Street skin clinic founded in 2010 is a strength, but dead menu links and an empty testimonials section appear to cost you consultations.

findings.problem: The main menu items Treatments and Conditions, the Skin and Face and Body headers and every Back link appear to point to #.
findings.cost: Visitors cannot browse your treatments from the menu.
findings.fix: A working treatment and condition menu.

findings.problem: The Our Testimonials heading appears with no testimonials beneath it, and thousands of quality procedures appears claimed with no evidence.
findings.cost: Cosmetic clients choose by proof, and an empty proof section loses them.

findings.problem: The brand appears as London City Skin Clinic in the header and London Skin Clinic in the footer, and the Nefertiti page address appears misspelled.
findings.cost: Mixed names and typos confuse visitors and weaken trust.
findings.fix: One brand name and proofread addresses.

findings.problem: The footer appears to read 2023, no opening hours appear, and the Beaconsfield clinic appears listed with no address or booking route.
findings.cost: Old dates and missing hours cost bookings.
findings.fix: A current footer, visible hours and full location details.

redesign: One brand name, hours and full locations.
